author: Shrimpy
body:
Greetings

The support service here seems like a very useful tool; unfortunately it's been nearly 2 weeks since I sent out something to it. Other users seems to have this problem as well with the support not replying as soon as they say they would. Once thing I would like is for it to be faster because a lot of users seem to have things to address to the staff and it looks as if they're not being heard enough.

Anyone else agree?

Yours truly,
Bronson, a.k.a.TheBron_cool

replies.body:
Well since you're banned i'm guessing you sent a ban appeal, maybe have a better message title? such as Ban appeal: i don't hack (video proof) <-- if you have video proof.
What i'm trying to say is better message titles make operators rather click on them first.
Btw this is just a suggestion i'm not trying to say you don't have appropriate message titles since i don't know what you've written in the email.
